# RUD. Produkte aus Stahl. Lösungen aus Leidenschaft.

Wir denken Technik weiter. Seit über 150 Jahren.

Fortschritt entsteht, wenn Vordenker Unmögliches möglich machen. In diesem Sinne prägt RUD als
Taktgeber seit mehr als 150 Jahren die Märkte weltweit. Aus dem Pionier der Rundstahlkette ist ein
internationaler Familienkonzern geworden. Heute engagieren sich über 1.700 Mitarbeitende in mehr als
120 Ländern dafür, dass das Fördern, Heben, Ziehen, Anschlagen und Zurren sowie der Reifenschutz und
Gleitschutz für Sie noch leichter und effizienter wird. Mit Innovationsgeist, Erfahrung und viel
Know-how.

Von der Zurrkette bis zum Anschlagpunkt, von der Reifenkette bis zum Fördersystem: Jede RUD Lösung
vereint für Sie durchdachtes Produktdesign, fundiertes Know-how und hohe Fertigungstiefe. Wir sind
davon überzeugt, dass Fortschritt durch konsequentes Hinterfragen und den Mut entsteht, bewährte
Lösungen für Sie noch besser zu machen. Für Lösungen und Technologien, die Ihre Welt nachhaltig nach
vorne bewegen. Willkommen bei RUD.
 

[Schwerlastkomponente mit RUD-Anschlagpunkten wird in Produktionshalle per Kran gehoben.]

## Anspruch trifft Innovationskraft.

Es ist unser Anspruch, Ihre Arbeit effizienter, sicherer und leichter zu machen. Und das schon seit
1875. Mit kompromisslosem Qualitätsdenken und herausragender Innovationskraft entwickeln wir
Lösungen, die Sie bewegen. Für das Fördern und Ziehen ebenso wie für das Heben, Anschlagen und
Zurren.

 

[Mehr über RUD erfahren][133]

[Eingangsschild der RUD-Zentrale im Werk Unterkochen mit Blick auf Natur und Grünanlagen.]
[In einer modernen Werkhalle arbeitet ein Rud Mitarbeiter mit Schutzbrille an einer CNC-Maschine,
während ein weiterer RUD Mitarbeiter mit Schutzbrille ihm aufmerksam dabei zusieht.]

## Mehr bewegen: Ihre Karriere bei RUD.

Bei RUD bewegen wir nicht nur Technik – Sie bewegen sich selbst nach vorne. Als Familienkonzern mit
globalem Anspruch bieten wir Perspektiven, die zu Ihnen passen. Ob Praktikum, Ausbildung oder
Direkteinstieg: Zeigen Sie, was in Ihnen steckt.

# RUD. Produkte aus Stahl. Lösungen aus Leidenschaft.

Wir denken Technik weiter. Seit über 150 Jahren.

Fortschritt entsteht, wenn Vordenker Unmögliches möglich machen. In diesem Sinne prägt RUD als
Taktgeber seit mehr als 150 Jahren die Märkte weltweit. Aus dem Pionier der Rundstahlkette ist ein
internationaler Familienkonzern geworden. Heute engagieren sich über 1.700 Mitarbeitende in mehr als
120 Ländern dafür, dass das Fördern, Heben, Ziehen, Anschlagen und Zurren sowie der Reifenschutz und
Gleitschutz für Sie noch leichter und effizienter wird. Mit Innovationsgeist, Erfahrung und viel
Know-how.

Von der Zurrkette bis zum Anschlagpunkt, von der Reifenkette bis zum Fördersystem: Jede RUD Lösung
vereint für Sie durchdachtes Produktdesign, fundiertes Know-how und hohe Fertigungstiefe. Wir sind
davon überzeugt, dass Fortschritt durch konsequentes Hinterfragen und den Mut entsteht, bewährte
Lösungen für Sie noch besser zu machen. Für Lösungen und Technologien, die Ihre Welt nachhaltig nach
vorne bewegen. Willkommen bei RUD.
 

[Schwerlastkomponente mit RUD-Anschlagpunkten wird in Produktionshalle per Kran gehoben.]

Barrierefreies Bad

## Anspruch trifft Innovationskraft.

Es ist unser Anspruch, Ihre Arbeit effizienter, sicherer und leichter zu machen. Und das schon seit
1875. Mit kompromisslosem Qualitätsdenken und herausragender Innovationskraft entwickeln wir
Lösungen, die Sie bewegen. Für das Fördern und Ziehen ebenso wie für das Heben, Anschlagen und
Zurren.

 

[Mehr über RUD erfahren][133]

[Eingangsschild der RUD-Zentrale im Werk Unterkochen mit Blick auf Natur und Grünanlagen.]
[In einer modernen Werkhalle arbeitet ein Rud Mitarbeiter mit Schutzbrille an einer CNC-Maschine,
während ein weiterer RUD Mitarbeiter mit Schutzbrille ihm aufmerksam dabei zusieht.]

## Mehr bewegen: Ihre Karriere bei RUD.

Bei RUD bewegen wir nicht nur Technik – Sie bewegen sich selbst nach vorne. Als Familienkonzern mit
globalem Anspruch bieten wir Perspektiven, die zu Ihnen passen. Ob Praktikum, Ausbildung oder
Direkteinstieg: Zeigen Sie, was in Ihnen steckt.

 

[Karrieremöglichkeiten entdecken][134]

## Choose Tire Chains by Driving Condition

Different tire chains perform better in different conditions. Use this guide to narrow down the best
chain style for snow, ice, mud, paved roads, Load Range E tires, or deep-lug tractor tires.

[

### Best for Ice

Studded tire chains usually provide the most aggressive ice traction. V-bar chains are also strong
for ice, hardpack, hills, and rougher conditions.

Compare ice chains → ][131] [

### Best for Road Use

Cable chains, diagonal cable chains, smooth ladder chains, Alpha Trax style chains, and some diamond
chains are better choices for paved roads when clearance allows.

Compare road-use chains → ][132] [

### Best for Mud & Off-Road

Heavy ladder chains, square link chains, thicker cross chains, and aggressive link chains are better
for mud, woods, deep snow, and rough terrain.

Compare off-road chains → ][133] [

### Best for Tractors

Duo-grip, duo ladder, double ring, ladder, studded, and heavy tractor chains are built for deep
lugs, fields, hills, snow, mud, and heavy pulling work.

## How We Recommend Tire Chains

TireChain.com recommends chains based on tire size, vehicle type, tread style, chain clearance, road
surface, and the conditions where the chains will be used.

### Ice, Hardpack, and Hills

Studded chains are usually the most aggressive choice for ice. V-bar chains are often the next
choice for strong bite on ice, hardpack, hills, and demanding winter use.

[Learn more about ice traction →][136]

### Paved Roads and Highway Use

Cable chains, diagonal cable chains, Alpha Trax style chains, smoother ladder chains, and some
diamond chains are usually better choices for road use when the vehicle has clearance.

[Learn more about road-use chains →][137]

### Mud, Deep Snow, and Off-Road Work

For mud, woods, fields, deep snow, and off-road work, heavier link chains are better. Thicker cross
chains and square link chains put more chain profile on the tire when clearance allows.

[Learn more about mud and off-road chains →][138]

### Load Range E and Aggressive Truck Tires

Load Range E, all-terrain, mud-terrain, KO2-style, and deep-lug truck tires can run larger than
standard passenger tire sizing suggests. They often need special fitment attention.

[Learn more about Load Range E fitment →][139]

### Diamond Chains and Cable Chains

Diamond and cable-style chains can be excellent for road use and smoother driving, but they are not
usually the best choice for deep mud, aggressive off-road truck use, or oversized Load Range E
tires.

[Compare diamond, cable, and link chains →][140]

### Tractor and Deep-Lug Tires

Farm tractor, garden tractor, turf, R1, R4, and industrial tread tires need recommendations based on
tread depth, tire shape, clearance, and whether the tractor is used on pavement, snow, mud, fields,
hills, or heavy pulling work.

[Learn more about tractor chains →][141]

## Why Buy Tire Chains Direct from TireChain.com?

Tire chains are a fitment product. Tire size, vehicle type, chain clearance, road surface, and use
condition all matter. Buying from a tire chain specialist helps you get the right chain the first
time.

Shop tire chains for passenger vehicles, commercial trucks, tractors, loaders, forklifts, ATVs,
UTVs, skid steers, skidders, and snow removal equipment.

### Direct Warehouse Shipping

TireChain.com sells direct without unnecessary middlemen, helping customers get better selection,
competitive prices, and fast fulfillment.

### Fitment and Chain Style Help

We help customers understand tire size, chain width, cross chain style, link thickness, ride
quality, traction level, and paved-surface damage concerns.

### Custom and Hard-to-Find Sizes

If you cannot find your tire size, we may be able to help identify a close match, recommend a
different chain style, or build a custom option.

## Customer Reviews

TireChain.com has 3,800+ verified customer reviews, plus Google Store review data saved from the
most recent successful check and refreshed regularly.

### Need Help Choosing Tire Chains?

Start with the tire size printed on the sidewall. Then choose the vehicle type and the main
condition you are driving in: paved road, snow, ice, mud, off-road, or field use. TireChain.com can
help with hard-to-find sizes, Load Range E fitment, aggressive tread tires, tractor tires, and
custom tire chain questions.

Quick answers to common tire chain fitment and buying questions.

### How do I know what tire chains fit my tire?

Use the tire size printed on the sidewall of your tire. Match that size to the correct tire chain
category or shop by tire size to narrow the options by vehicle type and use condition.

### Are snow chains and tire chains the same thing?

Yes. Customers often use snow chains, tire chains, and traction chains to describe chains installed
on tires for snow, ice, mud, or off-road traction.

### What tire chains are best for ice?

Studded chains are usually the most aggressive choice for ice. V-bar chains are also a strong option
for hardpack, ice, hills, and off-road traction. See the full guide: [Best Tire Chains for
Ice][145].

### What chains are best for paved roads?

For paved road use, smoother-riding chains, cable chains, diagonal cable chains, Alpha Trax style
chains, and some diamond-pattern chains are usually better choices than aggressive studded or V-bar
chains.

### Can tire chains damage blacktop or concrete?

## How We Recommend Tire Chains

TireChain.com recommends chains based on tire size, vehicle type, tread style, chain clearance, road
surface, and the conditions where the chains will be used.

### Ice, Hardpack, and Hills

Studded chains are usually the most aggressive choice for ice. V-bar chains are often the next
choice for strong bite on ice, hardpack, hills, and demanding winter use.

[Learn more about ice traction →][136]

### Paved Roads and Highway Use

Cable chains, diagonal cable chains, Alpha Trax style chains, smoother ladder chains, and some
diamond chains are usually better choices for road use when the vehicle has clearance.

[Learn more about road-use chains →][137]

### Mud, Deep Snow, and Off-Road Work

For mud, woods, fields, deep snow, and off-road work, heavier link chains are better. Thicker cross
chains and square link chains put more chain profile on the tire when clearance allows.

[Learn more about mud and off-road chains →][138]

### Load Range E and Aggressive Truck Tires

Load Range E, all-terrain, mud-terrain, KO2-style, and deep-lug truck tires can run larger than
standard passenger tire sizing suggests. They often need special fitment attention.

[Learn more about Load Range E fitment →][139]

### Diamond Chains and Cable Chains

Diamond and cable-style chains can be excellent for road use and smoother driving, but they are not
usually the best choice for deep mud, aggressive off-road truck use, or oversized Load Range E
tires.

[Compare diamond, cable, and link chains →][140]

### Tractor and Deep-Lug Tires

Farm tractor, garden tractor, turf, R1, R4, and industrial tread tires need recommendations based on
tread depth, tire shape, clearance, and whether the tractor is used on pavement, snow, mud, fields,
hills, or heavy pulling work.

[Learn more about tractor chains →][141]

## Tire Chain FAQ

### How do I know what tire chains fit my tire?

Use the tire size printed on the sidewall of your tire. Match that size to the correct tire chain
category or shop by tire size to narrow the options by vehicle type and use condition.

### Are snow chains and tire chains the same thing?

Yes. Customers often use snow chains, tire chains, and traction chains to describe chains installed
on tires for snow, ice, mud, or off-road traction.

### What tire chains are best for ice?

Studded chains are usually the most aggressive choice for ice. V-bar chains are also a strong option
for hardpack, ice, hills, and off-road traction. See the full guide: [Best Tire Chains for
Ice][145].

### What chains are best for paved roads?

For paved road use, smoother-riding chains, cable chains, diagonal cable chains, Alpha Trax style
chains, and some diamond-pattern chains are usually better choices than aggressive studded or V-bar
chains.

### Can tire chains damage blacktop or concrete?

Yes. Aggressive chains such as studded chains and V-bar chains can mark or damage paved surfaces.

## Atliprime Auto Snow Sock

## How to use Auto snow sock

– The Atli Snow Sock is built to get you  out of trouble and not for prolonged use. You should take
them off once on a gritted or clear road.
– The  Snow Sock  is designed to be used on tarmac / asphalt road with Snow & Ice
– Off road conditions where the road  is uneven will damage the product,
– Continued use on roads where now and ice is cleared will wear down the sock.
– Do not exceed 50 km/h. Do not make sudden braking or acceleration movements. Turn smoothly to
avoid skidding – i.e no sudden / jerky movements.
– Reduce speed further on wet snow.
– Dry socks before packing away wash after winter is over and store.
– Do not leave them on overnight or store in area where they can freeze, if this should happen do
not drive on the socks ontil it has naturally dried out.

## Atliprime Auto Snow Sock

## How to use Auto snow sock

– The Atli Snow Sock is built to get you  out of trouble and not for prolonged use. You should take
them off once on a gritted or clear road.
– The  Snow Sock  is designed to be used on tarmac / asphalt road with Snow & Ice
– Off road conditions where the road  is uneven will damage the product,
– Continued use on roads where now and ice is cleared will wear down the sock.
– Do not exceed 50 km/h. Do not make sudden braking or acceleration movements. Turn smoothly to
avoid skidding – i.e no sudden / jerky movements.
– Reduce speed further on wet snow.
– Dry socks before packing away wash after winter is over and store.
– Do not leave them on overnight or store in area where they can freeze, if this should happen do
not drive on the socks ontil it has naturally dried out.

# AutoSock. The Original Snow Socks, since 1998.

[FIND YOUR SIZE][28]

## The Textile Snow Chains for Winter Driving on Snow and Ice are the Highest Certified Textile
## Traction Devices Worldwide

AutoSock is the new generation of winter traction devices. Made of textile, it is pulled over the
driving wheels of cars, vans, trucks, buses and forklifts when extra grip is needed in winterly
conditions.[ As the highest certified of its kind, AutoSock is a legal solution for cars and
commercial vehicles.][29]

AutoSock takes three minutes to install – even on vehicles with low clearance. The textile is
damage-free to alloy rims and our sizes fit nearly every tire dimension. When not in use, our
lightweight and compact products can be easily stored year round in the trunk.

[ FIND YOUR AUTOSOCK ][30]

## TIRE SOCKS ARE USED BY FAMILIES, AMBULANCES, FIREFIGHTERS, ROADSIDE ASSISTANCE, PUBLIC SERVICES
## AND AIRPORTS

## CERTIFIED BY LEADING INTERNATIONAL STANDARDS
* [Logo AutoSock is tested and certified by European Standard EN16662-1]
* [Logo AutoSock complies with Swiss snow chain regulations]
* [Logo AutoSock in compliance with ÖNORM V5121]
* [Logo AutoSock complies with French Mountain Law Loi Montagne]
* [Logo CE AutoSock is traded freely in any part of the European Economic Area]

AutoSock is a legal alternative to metallic snow chains for cars and also trucks in the majority of
Northern America, Europe and Asia. AutoSock is certified according to the latest standards such as
the new European winter traction standard EN16662-1:2020 for passenger cars and is a legal
alternative to snow chains in any EU member state except Austria. In addition, AutoSock is
officially accepted in Switzerland when snow chains are mandatory. For a detailed overview, please
see our regulations page.

  AutoSock has become an essential for roadside emergency kits. Faced with unpredictable weather,
  the quick and space-saving solution keeps you moving.
  
  Find your nearest AutoSock dealer.

  AutoSock is the only textile traction aid not just approved by automotive manufacturers, but

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS FROM ALL OVER THE WORLD (FAQ)

### How do snow socks work?

Textiles tend to stick to dry snow and ice. The arranged fibres, used for the road contact fabric of
AutoSock, facilitate the textile to absorb and ‘wick away’ any water between the ground and the
tire, thereby maximizing the dry friction grip. Each thread of the road contact fabric consists of
more than 100 fine high-performance fibres, which lead to a “hairy” surface of the AutoSock traction
fabric. These “hairs” penetrate the slippery water film and connect the tires directly to the
surface (snow). With correct use, AutoSock becomes “hairier” and even improves performance over
time.

### Snow socks vs chains: How does AutoSock perform compared to winter tires and metallic tire
### chains? 

Proper winter tires (not 'all season' tyres) are an excellent choice for the winter months but they
have their limitations. Winter tires lose grip when the combination of snow and slope counts against
them. Drivers worldwide are using AutoSock on winter tires to e.g., climb steeper hills on icy roads
and for making safe descents in loaded vehicles. 

AutoSock does meet all performance, safety and durability requirements of any snow chain standard
worldwide. AutoSock can be more effective than snow chains in many situations, especially on ice. 

### Are textile tire socks legal? 

AutoSock is a legal alternative to snow chains (tire chains) for cars and also trucks in the
majority of Northern America, Europe and Asia. AutoSock is certified according to the latest
standards such as the new European winter traction standard EN16662-1:2020 for passenger cars and is
a legal alternative to snow chains in any EU member state except Austria. In addition, AutoSock is
officially accepted in Switzerland when snow chains are mandatory. For a detailed overview, please
see our [regulations page][35].

### How durable are textile snow chains?

We initiate and support testing both in-house and through third parties on a regular basis. In order
to obtain certification according to new EN16662-1:2020, AutoSock must pass at least 120km on dry
asphalt without any safety relevant damages. In addition, durability is tested on snow-covered test
tracks for several hundred kilometres. AutoSock warrants proper use and we highly recommend reading
the included instructions before use. By avoiding unnecessary wheelspin and longer distances on
clear roads, AutoSock will last a long time.

If driven according to instructions and solely on clean snow and ice, AutoSock will last several
hundred kilometers. The [photo here][36] shows AutoSock mounted and driven on a Tesla Model Y for
500km on a Norwegian country road in January 2024. AutoSock was still in great shape after 500km
without significant damage.

# About Citamyne

Citamyne is a precision instrument brand with a single focus: professional-grade digital kitchen
scales.

From the start, we've channeled our passion into perfecting every detail—from food-safe,
anti-fingerprint surfaces to high-sensitivity sensor systems that deliver instant, accurate
readings. We refuse to compromise, prioritizing the delicate balance between pinpoint precision and
effortless everyday usability.

Accuracy Engineered into Design
We study real cooking behaviors to achieve optimal responsiveness and stability. Whether you're
portioning ingredients for baking, tracking macros, or experimenting with new recipes, Citamyne
creates a reliable weighing companion tailored to your kitchen.

Listening to Our Customers
As a compact team, we stay agile—attentive to your real-world needs and feedback. Your voice
directly shapes our continuous refinement.

What we make is more than a "scale." It's your silent sous-chef for consistency, your tool for
culinary creativity, and your trusted partner for healthier choices.

Citamyne—Measure your mastery.
